role_summary: Lead the support team for critical IT infrastructure, ensuring operational stability, robust change control, and continuous improvement through automation within a large-scale enterprise environment.
must_have_requirements: University degree in IT or related field
Minimum 15 years of IT infrastructure support experience
Proven experience in production incident management
Expertise in IT risk management, compliance, and change control procedures
Experience managing vendor relationships and internal stakeholder communication
nice_to_have_requirements: Prior experience in Capital Markets or highly regulated financial environments
Demonstrated track record of infrastructure automation/enhancement projects
Direct experience managing enterprise infrastructure budgets

scoring_criteria.name: Total IT Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires high level of technical maturity to manage critical capital market infrastructure.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: 12-14 years may be acceptable if highly relevant

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership Tenure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must demonstrate direct experience managing teams in an enterprise setting.

scoring_criteria.name: Production Incident Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: System stability is critical in capital markets.

scoring_criteria.name: Governance & Compliance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Essential for regulatory adherence in financial markets.

scoring_criteria.name: Budget & Resource Planning
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Responsibility for managing departmental financial and human capital.

scoring_criteria.name: Infrastructure Automation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Matches requirement for continuous enhancement plans.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Needs to unify divergent teams and manage C-suite expectations.

scoring_criteria.name: Communication & Presence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Critical for presenting risks and strategy to senior management.

summary_focus: Highlight 15+ years of IT operations leadership in large-scale environments
Mention experience handling high-availability systems with critical SLAs
do_not_overclaim: Avoid claiming direct software development background if the primary focus was SRE/Infrastructure support

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position yourself as an stabilizer and optimizer who aligns infrastructure performance with business purpose
bridge_gaps_honestly: Emphasize how past leadership roles transformed operational culture if specific financial tech experience is limited
